title: fix(vue): apply themeData after the animation loads

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+'@lottiefiles/dotlottie-vue': patch
+---

+fix: apply `themeData` after the animation loads, so the initial value and later `src` changes keep the custom theme
